name: Network & Connectivity
why: Customer expansion, distributed operations or explicit network activity can create requirements for connectivity, capacity, resilience and service assurance.
who: Network / Infrastructure / IT Operations / Technology leadership
conversation: What connectivity, capacity, resilience or site-integration requirements are changing as the business expands or modernises?
next_step: Identify the technology owner and validate current network architecture, capacity constraints, resilience requirements and upcoming site changes.

name: Data Centre & Infrastructure
why: Business growth, new facilities and workload expansion can create demand for compute, storage, hosting, resilience, backup/DR and lifecycle services.
who: Data Centre / Infrastructure / IT Operations leadership
conversation: What new workloads, sites or capacity requirements are expected, and where are infrastructure, hosting or resilience gaps?
next_step: Validate workload growth, hosting model, infrastructure capacity, backup/DR and lifecycle requirements with the infrastructure owner.

name: Cloud & AI Infrastructure
capability: Cloud, AI Infrastructure, GPU/Compute, Managed Cloud
why: Digital, data and AI initiatives can increase demand for scalable compute, cloud, storage, networking, security and managed infrastructure.
who: CIO / CTO / Cloud / AI / Digital Technology leadership
conversation: Which digital, data, AI or application workloads are moving into delivery, and what cloud, compute, hosting and integration requirements follow?
next_step: Validate workloads, cloud model, compute/GPU needs, data residency, security and hybrid integration requirements.

name: Cybersecurity & Resilience
capability: Cybersecurity, SOC, DDoS, Backup/DR, Zero Trust, Resilience
why: Digital growth, new sites, integration and resilience requirements can increase the need for protection, continuity, recovery and managed security.
who: CISO / Security / Risk / Infrastructure / IT Operations leadership
conversation: How are new business, technology or site initiatives changing your security, continuity, recovery and compliance requirements?
next_step: Identify the security/resilience owner and qualify architecture, priority gaps, regulatory drivers and upcoming refresh or managed-security needs.

name: Enterprise Managed Services
capability: Managed Services, ICT Operations, Cloud Operations, Digital Transformation
why: Expansion and transformation programmes can create external delivery, migration, integration, operations and managed-service requirements.
who: CIO / CTO / Digital Transformation / IT Operations leadership
conversation: Which programmes are entering delivery, and where do you need external delivery capacity, integration support or ongoing managed operations?
next_step: Map active programmes to Otech delivery and managed-service capabilities and identify the programme or operations owner.
